title: ModelPricing
description:
Per-million-token pricing for a model, supplied by whoever constructs it.

The crate ships no built-in price list: a vendor table would be stale the week it ships, so rates are operator configuration attached to the model.

cached_input_per_million.description: USD per million cache-served prompt tokens. When absent, cached tokens bill at the full input rate.

input_per_million.description: USD per million uncached prompt tokens.
